note: The Rootway. Endpoints, class and path length are RI-WLD01 §4; the ROUTE between them is A* over the built terrain, so the road goes round the ridge and crosses at the narrows. Each leg carries its own elevation profile and the game blends the ground to it, which is what makes a causeway a causeway instead of a decal on a marsh.

settlement_join.rule: roads yield; buildings never move (ARBITRATION S28)
settlement_join.reads: game/src/render/exterior.js planSettlement(), over game/data/world/settlements/*.json and game/data/world/interiors/*.json — the same function game/src/world/province.js builds the collision walls from
settlement_join.footprints: the union of planSettlement(doc, interiors) and planSettlement(doc, {}) — they differ for 114 of 202 buildings and the game uses the former
